text.card: A star about 39 parsecs away, 1.3 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.3 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,071 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 108147
quotes.card: HD 108147, also known as Tupã, is a 7th magnitude star in the constellation of Crux in direct line with and very near to the bright star Acrux or Alpha Crucis.
quotes.introduction: It is either a yellow-white or yellow dwarf, slightly brighter and more massive than the Sun.
